statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attacks
The patient has a personal history of cerebral infarction
Long-term continuous ECG monitoring (CPT 93247) is ordered
The service is to evaluate for occult cardiac rhythm disturbances
The claim was denied under reason code CO-22
The denial reason is that care may be covered by another payer per coordination of benefits protocols
